arxiv-2103-00062.title: Revisiting the analysis of HW Vir eclipse timing data
arxiv-2103-00062.creator: Ekrem. M. Esmer, Özgür Baştürk ,, Tobias C. Hinse, Selim O. Selam, Alexandre C. M. Correia
arxiv-2103-00062.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Ekrem. M. Esmer, Özgür Baştürk ,, Tobias C. Hinse, Selim O. Selam, Alexandre C. M. Correia. HW Vir is a short-period binary that presents eclipse timing variations. Circumbinary planets have been proposed as a possible explanation, although the properties of the planets differ in each new study. Our aim is to perform robust model selection methods for eclipse timing variations (ETV) and error calculation techniques based on a frequentist approach for the case of the HW Vir system.

arxiv-2107-02640.title: Optical effects of domain walls
arxiv-2107-02640.creator: Valentin V. Khoze, Daniel L. Milne
arxiv-2107-02640.description: Abstract Domain walls arise in theories where there is spontaneous symmetry breaking of a discrete symmetry such as ℤ N \mathbb{Z}_{N} and are a feature of many BSM models. In this work we consider the possibility of detecting domain walls through their optical effects and specify three different methods of coupling domain walls to the photon.

arxiv-2109-04239.title: From the Sigma-type to the Grothendieck construction
arxiv-2109-04239.creator: Iosif Petrakis
arxiv-2109-04239.description: Abstract We translate properties of the Sigma-type in Martin-Löf Type Theory ( MLTT ) (\mathrm{MLTT}) to properties of the Grothendieck construction in category theory. Namely, equivalences in MLTT \mathrm{MLTT} that involve the Sigma-type motivate isomorphisms between corresponding categories that involve the Grothendieck construction.

arxiv-2203-09174.title: Nearest Neighbor Classifier with Margin Penalty for Active Learning
arxiv-2203-09174.creator: Yuan Cao, Zhiqiao Gao, Jie Hu, Mingchuan Yang, Jinpeng Chen✉
arxiv-2203-09174.description: Abstract As deep learning becomes the mainstream in the field of natural language processing, the need for suitable active learning method are becoming unprecedented urgent. Active Learning (AL) methods based on nearest neighbor classifier are proposed and demonstrated superior results. However, existing nearest neighbor classifiers are not suitable for classifying mutual exclusive classes because inter-class discrepancy cannot be assured.

arxiv-2203-16794.title: MMER: Multimodal Multi-task Learning for Speech Emotion Recognition
arxiv-2203-16794.creator: Sreyan Ghosh ♠ , Utkarsh Tyagi ♠ , S Ramaneswaran ♣ , Harshvardhan Srivastava \varheartsuit {}^{\varheartsuit} , Dinesh Manocha ♠
arxiv-2203-16794.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose MMER , a novel M ultimodal M ulti-task learning approach for Speech E motion R ecognition. MMER leverages a novel multimodal network based on early-fusion and cross-modal self-attention between text and acoustic modalities and solves three novel auxiliary tasks for learning emotion recognition from spoken utterances.

arxiv-2205-07123.title: The VoicePrivacy 2020 Challenge Evaluation Plan Version 1.4
arxiv-2205-07123.creator: Natalia Tomashenko, Brij Mohan Lal Srivastava, Xin Wang, Emmanuel Vincent, Andreas Nautsch, Junichi Yamagishi, Nicholas Evans, Jose Patino, Jean-François Bonastre, Paul-Gauthier Noé, Massimiliano Todisco
arxiv-2205-07123.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Natalia Tomashenko, Brij Mohan Lal Srivastava, Xin Wang, Emmanuel Vincent, Andreas Nautsch, Junichi Yamagishi, Nicholas Evans, Jose Patino, Jean-François Bonastre, Paul-Gauthier Noé, Massimiliano Todisco. The VoicePrivacy Challenge aims to promote the development of privacy preservation tools for speech technology by gathering a new community to define the tasks of interest and the evaluation methodology, and benchmarking solutions through a series of challenges.

arxiv-2503-20288.title: Impact of the Pilot Design for OFDM Based Bi-static Integrated Sensing and Communication System
arxiv-2503-20288.creator: Cuneyd Ozturk Member, IEEE, Cagri Goken Member, IEEE
arxiv-2503-20288.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Cuneyd Ozturk Member, IEEE, Cagri Goken Member, IEEE. A bistatic millimeter-wave (mmWave) ISAC system utilizing OFDM signaling is considered. For a single-target scenario, closed-form expressions for the Cramer-Rao bounds (CRBs) of range and velocity estimation are derived for a given pilot pattern. The analysis shows that when the target’s range and velocity remain within the maximum unambiguous limits, allocating pilot symbols more frequently in time improves position estimation, while increasing their density in frequency enhances velocity estimation.

arxiv-2506-17346.title: A Novel Multi-layer Task-centric and Data Quality Framework for Autonomous Driving
arxiv-2506-17346.creator: Yuhan Zhou, Haihua Chen, Kewei Sha
arxiv-2506-17346.description: Abstract The next-generation autonomous vehicles (AVs), embedded with frequent real-time decision-making, will rely heavily on a large volume of multisource and multimodal data. In real-world settings, the data quality (DQ) of different sources and modalities usually varies due to unexpected environmental factors or sensor issues.

pmc-10555843.title: Statistically unbiased prediction enables accurate denoising of voltage imaging data
pmc-10555843.creator: Minho Eom, Seungjae Han, Pojeong Park, Gyuri Kim, Eun-Seo Cho, Jueun Sim, Kang-Han Lee, Seonghoon Kim, He Tian, Urs L Böhm, Eric Lowet, Hua-an Tseng, Jieun Choi, Stephani Edwina Lucia, Seung Hyun Ryu, Márton Rózsa, Sunghoe Chang, Pilhan Kim, Xue Han, Kiryl D Piatkevich, Myunghwan Choi, Cheol-Hee Kim
pmc-10555843.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Here we report SUPPORT (statistically unbiased prediction utilizing spatiotemporal information in imaging data), a self-supervised learning method for removing Poisson–Gaussian noise in voltage imaging data. SUPPORT is based on the insight that a pixel value in voltage imaging data is highly dependent on its spatiotemporal neighboring pixels, even when its temporally adjacent frames alone do not provide useful information for statistical prediction.

pmc-10637356.title: On-demand chlorine dioxide solution enhances odontoblast differentiation through desulfation of cell surface heparan sulfate proteoglycan and subsequent activation of canonical Wnt signaling
pmc-10637356.creator: Toshihiro Inubushi, Nag Priyanka, Masakatsu Watanabe, Yusuke Takahashi, Shinnosuke Kusano, Hiroshi Kurosaka, Silvana Papagerakis, Petros Papagerakis, Mikako Hayashi, Takashi Yamashiro
pmc-10637356.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Heparan sulfate proteoglycans (HSPGs) surround the surface of odontoblasts, and their modification affects their affinity for Wnt ligands. This study proposes applying Matching Transformation System® (MA-T), a novel chlorinated oxidant, to enhance dentinogenesis. MA-T treatment in odontoblasts decreased sulfation of HSPG and upregulated the expression of dentin sialophosphoprotein (Dspp) and Dentin Matrix Protein 1 (Dmp1) via activation of canonical Wnt signaling in vitro. Ex vivo application of MA-T also enhanced dentin matrix formation in developing tooth explants.

pmc-10646118.title: Prevalence, awareness, and patterns of non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug use among health science students in Palestine: a cross-sectional study
pmc-10646118.creator: Aseel I. Aboalrob, Falasteen M. Eid, Saba M. Esa, Amer A. Koni, Samah W. Al-Jabi, Sa’ed H. Zyoud
pmc-10646118.description: Despite the widespread use of nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs), many people lack sufficient awareness regarding their side effects and proper usage. Consequently, this study aimed to assess the knowledge, behavior, and usage patterns of NSAIDs among students enrolled in Palestinian health colleges.

pmc-11282241.title: Electrical properties determine the liquid flow direction in plasma–liquid interactions
pmc-11282241.creator: Calum T Ryan, Anton A Darhuber, Rudie P J Kunnen, Hanneke Gelderblom, Ana Sobota
pmc-11282241.description: During atmospheric pressure plasma impingement, plasma induced liquid flow will influence the transport and distribution of plasma generated charged and reactive species in liquids. We use particle image velocimetry and supplementary pH, conductivity and temperature measurements to investigate electrical properties of an AC kHz plasma jet interacting with water and electrolytes.

pmc-12468187.title: Primary Cilia and Cardiovascular Risk Factors in Alzheimer’s Disease
pmc-12468187.creator: Clare L Sunderman, Kathleen V Forero, Qasim Alorjani, Raghad Buqaileh, Gillian M Gallagher, Sestina M Ventresca, William S Messer, Wissam A AbouAlaiwi, Yoshikaszu Matsuda
pmc-12468187.description: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is the most common cause of dementia worldwide due to an aging population. AD is characterized as a progressive neurodegenerative disease that leads to atrophy of brain tissue, causing cognitive deficits. Amyloid beta plaques and neurofibrillary tangles are pathological hallmarks of AD, yet the cause is still highly debated.

pmc-12754185.title: Assessing the determinants and association of cognitive memory performance with blood folate and cobalamin levels in Qatar’s healthy aging population
pmc-12754185.creator: Hina Akram, Nasseer Masoodi, Muhammad Abd Ur Rehman, Zumin Shi, Manar E. Abdel-Rahman
pmc-12754185.description: IntroductionCognitive health, crucial for the independence and quality of life in older adults, is influenced by various factors, including nutritional status, which is increasingly recognized for its importance. Folate (vitamin B9) and cobalamin (vitamin B12) are essential for neurological health.

pmc-13049745.title: Early risperidone exposure impairs cognitive function by perturbation of the gut microbiome and bile acids/tyrosine-PTP1B axis
pmc-13049745.creator: Huaiyu Ye, Xiaoying Yang, Mingxuan Zheng, Wei Dong, Xi Chen, Jiajia Chen, Minmin Hu, Menglu Zhou, Peng Zheng, Lijun Shen, Yuqing Wu, Kuiyang Zheng, Xu-Feng Huang, Yinghua Yu
pmc-13049745.description: BackgroundSecond-generation antipsychotics (SGAs) are increasingly being utilized in children and adolescents. Risperidone, one of the most commonly prescribed SGAs in this population, has been found to adversely affect cognitive function; however, limited knowledge exists regarding the impact of risperidone on the gut microbiome-brain axis.

pmc-13063684.title: Wrist muscle performance in students with chronic nonspecific neck pain: an isokinetic assessment
pmc-13063684.creator: Mohamed Mahmoud Refaey, Enas Fawzy Youssef, Aness Saleh Gheit, Mohamed Abdelaziz Emam, Aya Abdelhamied Mohamed Khalil
pmc-13063684.description: BackgroundWork-related musculoskeletal disorders (WMSDs) are highly prevalent among physiotherapy students and therapists. This high prevalence highlights the specific link between sustained cervical loading which can precipitate nonspecific neck pain and upper extremity dysfunction, clarifying that proximal neck pain may contribute to distal upper extremity impairment.

pmc-13562396.title: Involvement of CgPGC-1α in regulating mitochondrial biogenesis in Pacific oyster Crassostrea gigas under ocean acidification
pmc-13562396.creator: Dongli Jiang, Hongbo Lu, Zhe Zhang, Chuanyan Yang, Chang Liu, Lingling Wang, Linsheng Song
pmc-13562396.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Highlights•CgPGC-1α with classical RRM domain was identified from Crassostrea gigas.•CgPGC-1α mRNA was ubiquitously expressed with the highest level in gill.•CgPGC-1α could respond to acidification treatment, promote mitochondrial biogenesis.•Acidification enhanced mitochondrial biogenesis and ATP via AMPKα/PGC-1α.Keywords: Crassostrea gigas, PGC-1α, Mitochondrial numbers, AMPKα, Ocean acidification

Introduction

The peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma coactivator-1 (PGC-1) is a member of the transcriptional coactivator family, and plays a crucial role in regulating energy metabolism in response to temperature, oxidation and exercise in fish and mammal [[1], [2], [3]].

pmc-13634475.description: Mechanical orthodontic treatment is regarded as a classical strategy for directional tooth movement in confront of malocclusion.
